provider: Mail.ru Cloud / Облако Mail (VK) — 1 TB with free public-link download

free_tier.stated: Free tier 8 GB with uploads up to 1 GB per file; a Mail Space subscription raises the per-file limit to 100 GB. Purchase page tiers: +256 GB, +512 GB, +1 TB and +2 TB (2.01 TB total).

egress.terms: unverified: no download-volume or egress term appears on the purchase page or the help pages read.

tooling: WebDAV endpoint live (`https://webdav.cloud.mail.ru/` -> 302 to auth). rclone `mailru` backend, alist/OpenList `mailru` driver, desktop sync client, official REST API. Upload up to 100 GB/file on paid tiers.
chaining: One account = one Cloud; the largest tier listed totals 2.01 TB, so the stored need takes several accounts; no documented route for that.
limits_note: The unlimited feature on the purchase page is unlimited auto-upload of phone photos and videos, which do not count against the space; it is not unlimited storage. The largest purchasable tier listed totals 2.01 TB. Free tier is 8 GB with a 1 GB per-file ceiling.

identity_cost.detail: A bank card is bound in the tariff payment window to buy a subscription (promotion terms); the sign-up form was not readable (shell page): unverified.

reliability_note: VK-owned, so politically exposed for a foreign user but technically stable for a decade. The ₽1,560 first-year price IS a trial price — steady state from year two is ₽3,000, a 92 % increase, and must be budgeted at ₽3,000. Plan maximum 4 TB means it cannot host 20 TiB at any price.
confidence_note: documented: the 8 GB free tier, the 1 GB per-file limit and the 100 GB limit with a subscription are quoted from https://help.mail.ru/cloud/files/upload/; the 2.01 TB largest tier total and the 224 rubles per month price from https://cloud.mail.ru/promo/quota/; the bank card requirement of the promotion from https://blog.mail.ru/terms_cloud_autumn_26/ (vendor pages read 2026-11-03); egress and the sign-up form were not read
